UNIT 1 · A1 · CORE MODULE

People: Personal Information

Learn to introduce yourself, exchange personal information and get to know other people in everyday situations.

🎯 Communicative goalIntroduce yourself and ask others about basic personal details.
🧠 Language focusBe, subject pronouns, possessive adjectives and Wh- questions.
🗣️ By the end, you can…Give a short personal introduction and ask simple questions.
🌎 Real-life contextMeeting someone for the first time.

PLANS & MEMBERSHIPS
START LEARNING

Basic

The complete self-paced course.

  • All 10 A1 units and learning objectives
  • Two recorded lessons per unit

  • Learning path, progress tracking and streaks
  • Access to the Resource Library
  • Automatic activity results for Listening and Reading
Course access
LEARN & GET RECOGNIZED

Premium

Everything in Basic, plus feedback and certification.

  • Everything included in Basic
  • AI-assisted Writing feedback and improvement suggestions

  • HOA course certification
  • Final certification assessment and certificate record
Basic + Feedback + Certification
LEARN WITH PEOPLE

Premium+

The full HOA experience with teacher interaction.

  • Everything included in Premium
  • Teacher-led speaking session for each unit

  • Opportunities to practise English with other learners
